[TODO:it] The flock sleeps under cold stars.
The night is long and still.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Your eyes stay on the hills.

sleep_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Stay Awake
sleep_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] A faithful watch is a holy thing.
Keep your post.

wander_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Return to the Flock
wander_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The sheep need your care tonight.
Go back to your post.

light.text:
[TODO:it] The night cracks open with glory.
An angel stands before you.

run_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The angel speaks gently to you.
Return and listen.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Your fear gives way to peace.

attack_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] This light brings news, not harm.
Receive it with reverence.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Your staff falls to the grass.

message.title: [TODO:it] Good News
message.text:
[TODO:it] "Today in Bethlehem a Savior is born.
You will find him in a manger."

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Your heart burns to see him.

doubt_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Trust the Sign
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] A child in a manger awaits.
Go and see for yourself.

travel.title: [TODO:it] Toward Bethlehem
travel.text:
[TODO:it] The road is dark but your steps are sure.
The town glows ahead.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Bring fine gifts to buy first

wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The Savior waits in a manger tonight.
Do not turn back.

gifts_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Empty Hands Are Enough
gifts_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] He receives the poor as the rich.
Go as you are.

worship.title: [TODO:it] The Child
worship.text:
[TODO:it] He lies in a manger, just as told.
His breath is soft, his face is light.

silence_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] He is the One the angel spoke of.
